# اُغْتُصِبَا (uḡtuṣibā) /uɣ.tu.sˤi.baː/: third-person masculine dual past passive of اِغْتَصَبَ (iḡtaṣaba)
# اِغْتَصِبَا (iḡtaṣibā) /iɣ.ta.sˤi.baː/: second-person dual imperative of اِغْتَصَبَ (iḡtaṣaba)
